referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Baker Roofing commercial contractor homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with an overlaid fleet-truck photograph with tightly stacked condensed white display text and a red contact action. It uses white two-tier commercial navigation with an immediate service control. The visual system relies on extra-condensed industrial caps against measured sans copy; surfaces include white, warm gray, charcoal, dark teal and accents include vivid orange red, teal. Imagery is working crews, service fleet, roof surfaces, archival photographs, and finished commercial projects. The page then runs through commercial navigation, fleet-truck hero, history and employee ownership chapter, photographic service matrix, team story, national accounts map, featured projects, roofing insights, contact footer. Its service presentation is asymmetric photo mosaic for repair, replacement, restoration, academy, construction, and accounts. Mobile changes to stack service mosaic cells in one column, preserve the large headings, and move request service before long company history. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy Baker marks, vehicle graphics, historical photographs, ownership claim, project names, account coverage, or staff photographs.
